body.label: Effect
body.html: Burn 1 die. Choose one ally within 5 units; it becomes Rallied.

surges.html: When this Rite's next Echo resolves, it may affect one additional eligible target.
If the Rite targets a Possessed creature, you may remove Possessed after an Echo resolves.

rider.title: OFFERING RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: You voluntarily burn a die while within 5 units of the Rite. Echo: One ally within 5 units becomes Rallied.
